## Setup
```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
```

```{r params}
module = "progenitors"
load_data = T #Loading initial seurat analysis
subset_data = T

rmd_filename = "supp_figS2_progenitor_integration_trial"
i_am(file.path("figures", paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))

```


```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal = c("#0A7EA8","#EF5780","#0A8550","#1C31D3","#EE9614","#670F39")
clusters = ggsci::pal_simpsons()(12)[c(1:7,9:15)]
prog_cols = c("#DA1819","#691A93","#EBB400" , "#434D51","#00AED1","#3AAD00","#FF7F00","#AC8AD0")
```

## RPCA, Harmony,  and FASTMNN
```{r}
dataname = "integration_trial"
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
```

```{r}
if (subset_data){
  tri = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
} else {
  tri = readRDS(here(odir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(tri) = "RNA"
}
tri
```


## RPCA
```{r}
method_name="rpca"
red_name = method_name
umap_name = paste("umap", sep=".", method_name)
clu_name = paste( method_name, sep="_", "clusters")
```

```{r rpcaA_init}
rpcaA = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "initial_clusters", cols=clusters, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white") + theme_hp +
    labs(title=NULL, color="Initial clusters", y="UMAP 2") + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=clusters, labels=function(x) paste0("u",x)) + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title.position = "top")
rpcaA
```

```{r rpcaB_subject}
rpcaB = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "subject", cols=pal, 
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white",shuffle = T) +
    theme_hp + labs(title=NULL, colour="Subject")+ 
        theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title.position = "top")
rpcaB
```


```{r rpcaC_new}
rpcaC = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = clu_name, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white", cols=prog_cols) + 
    theme_hp +labs(title=NULL, colour="Progenitor clusters (RPCA)") + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=prog_cols, labels=function(x) paste0("p",x)) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title.position = "top")
rpcaC
```

## SCVI Integration
```{r}
dataname = "scvi_integration"
odir = here("output", module, dataname)

method_name="scVI"
red_name = method_name
umap_name = paste("umap", sep=".", method_name)
clu_name = paste( method_name, sep="_", "clusters")
```

```{r}
if (subset_data){
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
} else {
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(sbs) = "RNA"
}
Idents(sbs) = clu_name
table(Idents(sbs))
```

```{r scvA_init}
scvA = DimPlot(sbs, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "initial_clusters", cols=clusters, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white") + theme_hp + labs(title=NULL, x="UMAP 1", y="UMAP 2") +
    scale_colour_manual(values=clusters, label=function(x) paste0("u",x))
scvA
```


```{r scvB_subject}
scvB = DimPlot(sbs, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "subject", cols=pal, 
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white",shuffle = T) +
    theme_hp + labs(title=NULL, x="UMAP 1")
scvB
```


```{r scvC_new}
scvC = DimPlot(sbs, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = clu_name, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T) +theme_hp + labs(title=NULL, x="UMAP 1")
scvC
```


### get legends
```{r}
initial_clu = get_legend(rpcaA)
subject = get_legend(rpcaB)
prog_clu = get_legend(rpcaC)
```


## Combined plot


```{r}
umaps = plot_grid(rpcaA +labs(x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          rpcaB +labs(y=NULL,x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          rpcaC+labs(y=NULL,x=NULL)+theme(legend.position = "none"),
          harmonyA +labs(x=NULL)+theme(legend.position = "none"),
          harmonyB +labs(x=NULL, y=NULL)+theme(legend.position = "none"),
          harmonyC +labs(y=NULL,x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          fastmnnA +labs(x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          fastmnnB +labs(y=NULL,x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          fastmnnC +labs(y=NULL,x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          scvA  +theme(legend.position = "none"), 
          scvB +labs(y=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"), 
          scvC +labs(y=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"), 
          ncol = 3)
umaps
```


```{r all_plots}
plot_grid(umaps, plot_grid(initial_clu, subject, prog_clu, nrow=1, rel_widths = c(1,0.6,0.8)), 
          rel_heights = c(1,0.15), ncol=1)  
ggsave(here(fig_dir, "progenitor_integration_trial.png"), width = 18, height= 26, units="cm", dpi = 600)
```
